title: On exact capacities
summary: We consider capacity (fuzzy measure, non-additive probability) on a compactum as a monotone cooperative normed game. We introduce topological analogues of well known class of exact games and show that these classes form subfunctors of the capacity functor which lie between known subfunctors of convex capacities and balanced capacities. It is natural to consider probability measures as elements of core of such games. We describe exact capacities as envelopes of the convex closed sets of probability measures.
